title: Podcast Scraper — Pipeline stages (RFC-109)
description: Per-episode processing manifest signal: the pipeline_stage events processing_manifest.update_stage emits per stage (RFC-109 / ADR-132), read from VictoriaLogs. Each query reads both the lines shipped before the Alloy unwrap stage (JSON behind the log prefix, extracted here) and after it (fields). Every panel follows the dashboard time range; log retention is 30 days. Correlate by run_id / episode_id. Cost is $0 on self-hosted models, so the cost panels are flat zero until a paid provider runs.

targets.expr: instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND (event_type:pipeline_stage OR "\"event_type\": \"pipeline_stage\"") | extract "{\"ts\"<rest>" | format "{\"ts\"<rest>" as ev | unpack_json from ev | stats by (stage) sum(cost_usd) usd

instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND (event_type:pipeline_stage OR "\"event_type\": \"pipeline_stage\"") | extract "{\"ts\"<rest>" | format "{\"ts\"<rest>" as ev | unpack_json from ev | stats by (run_id) sum(cost_usd) usd | sort by (usd desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Per-stage time spent (seconds)
panels.description: Only stages that record duration_s (asr, summary, gi, kg, translation); diarization, naming and turns do not.

targets.expr: instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND (event_type:pipeline_stage OR "\"event_type\": \"pipeline_stage\"") | extract "{\"ts\"<rest>" | format "{\"ts\"<rest>" as ev | unpack_json from ev | filter duration_s:* | stats by (stage) sum(duration_s) seconds

panels.title: Method-version inventory (reprocess key) — stage writes per stage×version
panels.description: Which stage logic is in play. Counts stage WRITES (≈ episodes on a fresh run; a re-run re-emits, so treat as an inventory of which method_versions exist, not a distinct-episode count). After shipping an improvement, rows on the OLD method_version are the reprocess target (ADR-132 §Convention 2).

targets.expr: instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND (event_type:pipeline_stage OR "\"event_type\": \"pipeline_stage\"") | extract "{\"ts\"<rest>" | format "{\"ts\"<rest>" as ev | unpack_json from ev | stats by (stage, method_version) count() writes | sort by (stage)

panels.title: Flagged stage-writes
panels.description: Stage writes carrying a rework quality_flag (e.g. unnamed_dominant_voice / empty_host_anchor / guest_in_title_not_placed / asr_speech_recovered). Phrase filter on the line, since the flags ship as a JSON array.

targets.expr: instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND "pipeline_stage" AND "quality_flags" | stats count() flagged

panels.title: ASR failovers
panels.description: Stage writes carrying the asr_failover flag (set in episode_processor when the primary ASR fails over). Zero is the expected value when none happened: the flag was not seen in any line in the 30-day retention.

targets.expr: instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND "pipeline_stage" AND "asr_failover" | stats count() failovers

panels.title: Recent flagged episodes
panels.description: Drill-down: the actual flagged stage writes (episode_id / stage / flags) for triage. Pivot to logs/traces/Sentry by run_id / episode_id.

targets.expr: instance:prod-podcast AND surface:pipeline AND "pipeline_stage" AND "quality_flags" | sort by (_time) desc limit 200
